title: A Night at the Cinema
setting: A cinema in town, then a cosy living room with a fireplace.

characters.name: Mia
characters.look: Mia, a young girl with short brown hair and a red sweater

characters.name: Sam
characters.look: Sam, a young boy with glasses and a blue shirt

sentences.en: Mia and Sam go to the cinema tonight.
sentences.zh: 米娅和萨姆今晚去电影院。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia, a young girl with short brown hair and a red sweater and Sam, a young boy with glasses and a blue shirt walk into a bright cinema in the evening.

sentences.en: First, they look at the snack menu.
sentences.zh: 他们先看了看零食菜单。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia, a young girl with short brown hair and a red sweater and Sam, a young boy with glasses and a blue shirt look up at a picture menu of popcorn and drinks at the cinema counter.

sentences.en: The film tells an exciting story.
sentences.zh: 这部电影讲了一个精彩的故事。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia, a young girl with short brown hair and a red sweater and Sam, a young boy with glasses and a blue shirt sit in the dark cinema with wide eyes, watching the big screen.

sentences.en: It is about a young Italian singer.
sentences.zh: 电影讲的是一位年轻的意大利歌手。
sentences.scene_prompt: On the big cinema screen, a young singer stands on a stage in a sunny Italian town.

sentences.en: She loves to sing and dance on stage.
sentences.zh: 她喜欢在舞台上唱歌跳舞。
sentences.scene_prompt: On the cinema screen, the young singer sings and dances on a stage under bright lights.

sentences.en: The dancing in the movie is beautiful.
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia, a young girl with short brown hair and a red sweater and Sam, a young boy with glasses and a blue shirt smile in their seats as dancers move across the cinema screen.

sentences.en: By the fire, Sam draws the singer.
sentences.zh: 萨姆在炉火旁画那位歌手。
sentences.scene_prompt: At home, Sam, a young boy with glasses and a blue shirt sits by a warm fireplace drawing a singer on paper.

sentences.en: Mia wants to be a movie writer one day.
sentences.zh: 米娅希望将来有一天成为电影编剧。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia, a young girl with short brown hair and a red sweater sits by the fireplace writing in a notebook and dreaming, next to Sam, a young boy with glasses and a blue shirt.
